_source: Gochara (transits) per Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950) Adhyaya 26, checked against the cached archive.org text: v. 1 (transits are judged from the natal Moon sign), v. 2 (Jupiter good in the 7th, 9th, 2nd and 5th; Saturn, like Mars, in the 6th and 3rd; all planets in the 11th), v. 5 (Saturn in the 3rd, 11th and 6th, subject to vedha), v. 7 (Jupiter in the 2nd, 11th, 9th, 5th and 7th, subject to vedha), vv. 18-20 (Jupiter's results house by house; v. 18 is partly illegible in the scan), vv. 22-23 (Saturn's results house by house). Vedha (obstruction) is not modelled. Sade Sati (Saturn in the 12th, 1st and 2nd from the Moon) and Dhaiya (4th and 8th) are the engine's phases; the names are later tradition, while the houses' results are Ph Ch 26 vv. 22-23. The deltas added to the monthly rating are this app's interpretive weights, not classical numbers.

jupiter_good.en: Jupiter transits the {house} house from your Moon sign, a supportive position in gochara.
jupiter_good.hi: गुरु आपकी चंद्र राशि से {house} भाव में गोचर कर रहे हैं, जो गोचर में सहायक स्थिति है।

jupiter_other.en: Jupiter transits the {house} house from your Moon sign, a less supportive position in gochara.
jupiter_other.hi: गुरु आपकी चंद्र राशि से {house} भाव में गोचर कर रहे हैं, जो गोचर में कम सहायक स्थिति है।

saturn_good.en: Saturn transits the {house} house from your Moon sign, one of its supportive positions in gochara.
saturn_good.hi: शनि आपकी चंद्र राशि से {house} भाव में गोचर कर रहे हैं, जो गोचर में उनकी सहायक स्थितियों में से एक है।

saturn_other.en: Saturn transits the {house} house from your Moon sign, a position that tends to ask for patience.
saturn_other.hi: शनि आपकी चंद्र राशि से {house} भाव में गोचर कर रहे हैं, यह स्थिति प्रायः धैर्य माँगती है।

sade_sati_rising.en: Sade Sati, rising phase: Saturn in the 12th from your Moon sign; expenses and effort may need watching.
sade_sati_rising.hi: साढ़ेसाती का आरंभिक चरण: शनि आपकी चंद्र राशि से 12वें भाव में; खर्च और परिश्रम पर ध्यान देना उचित रहेगा।
sade_sati_rising.ref: Phaladeepika Ch 26 vv. 1, 23 (12th house); Sade Sati: later tradition

sade_sati_peak.en: Sade Sati, peak phase: Saturn over your Moon sign; health and steady routines deserve care.
sade_sati_peak.hi: साढ़ेसाती का मध्य चरण: शनि आपकी चंद्र राशि पर; स्वास्थ्य और नियमित दिनचर्या पर ध्यान दें।
sade_sati_peak.ref: Phaladeepika Ch 26 vv. 1, 22 (Janma rasi); Sade Sati: later tradition

sade_sati_setting.en: Sade Sati, setting phase: Saturn in the 2nd from your Moon sign; family finances may need care.
sade_sati_setting.hi: साढ़ेसाती का अंतिम चरण: शनि आपकी चंद्र राशि से दूसरे भाव में; पारिवारिक धन पर ध्यान देना उचित रहेगा।
sade_sati_setting.ref: Phaladeepika Ch 26 vv. 1, 22 (2nd house); Sade Sati: later tradition

dhaiya_4th.en: Saturn's Dhaiya (4th from your Moon sign): home and relatives may need attention.
dhaiya_4th.hi: शनि की ढैया (चंद्र राशि से चौथा भाव): घर और संबंधियों पर ध्यान देना उचित रहेगा।
dhaiya_4th.ref: Phaladeepika Ch 26 vv. 1, 22 (4th house); Dhaiya: later tradition

dhaiya_8th.en: Saturn's Dhaiya (8th from your Moon sign): a time to go carefully with health and money.
dhaiya_8th.hi: शनि की ढैया (चंद्र राशि से आठवाँ भाव): स्वास्थ्य और धन के मामलों में सावधानी का समय।
dhaiya_8th.ref: Phaladeepika Ch 26 vv. 1, 22 (8th house); Dhaiya: later tradition

dasha.ref: Phaladeepika Ch 20 vv. 29, 41, 42 (period judged from its lords' nature, strength and mutual position)
